title: Tidewatch launch

shots.visual: generated clip: dawn on a rocky shore, tide far out, a small boat on the mud, gulls, no people; slow push-in, grey-blue light
shots.caption: Low tide. No bars.

shots.visual: a phone held at arm's length over the same shore, blurred behind it; the Tidewatch splash draws its wave mark and wordmark on the screen
shots.caption: Tidewatch

shots.visual: screen recording of the app: station list, a tap on Harbor Point, the tide curve draws, a marker lands on now, the next high water reads 7:48 AM
shots.caption: Harbor Point: next high water 7:48 AM

shots.visual: same phone, status bar flips to No service, a green Offline badge slides in, then the Harbor Point data pack card rises
shots.caption: Works fully offline with bundled tide data for two years

shots.visual: app price sheet slides up: Unlock every station, $4.99 one-time purchase, ticks for no account and no ads; a tap turns the button green
shots.caption: $4.99 one-time purchase

shots.visual: generated clip: the skipper's hands tie off a dinghy as the water floods back in, sun on the sandbar; the wordmark and tagline settle over it
shots.caption: Tidewatch. Tide tables in your pocket, no signal required. No accounts and no ads.
